The seven cases were selected from the successful 128-case Test42 matrix; they are now **self-contained production-test-suite candidates**, registered in `crates/engine/src/lib.rs`. Their **newer base and self-contained Oracle84 command fixture were independently built and tested here** rather than inheriting the earlier 128-case success.

## Honest scope boundary

This verifies the **already executable E2E-01/E2E-02 command/engine subsets only**. The **four full recipes in upstream Draft PR #8288 remain NOT RUN**. In particular, the test does not exercise actual automatic redraw in a visible U2 user-interface drawing, paper-rendered dimension labels/balloons, or real saved `.sc` file close/reopen preserving `historical_last_value_mm`. Session-only `last_good` is tested; persistence is not. 3,068 other engine tests were filtered out, so this is not full-project CI.

The author has asked CamWight for his preferred official integration location; **no answer or integration approval has yet been confirmed**. Keep this work on its fork-only test branch until agreement. The existing official Draft PR #8288 is unchanged.
